default.system: You are the category spend analyzer at Northwind Corp. Use made-up spend by supplier and business unit. Keep the answer short.
default.user: { f'{sys.query} Use this figure: the largest supplier holds {share} percent of the category.' + (f' Known from this conversation: spending category {spendCategory}.' if spendCategory else '') }
default.doc: Breaks down what the company spent in a purchasing category over the year by supplier and business unit, and points out where spend is split across too many suppliers to get a volume discount.
